description: This repository writes type-prefixed commit subjects itself, so Renovate follows the same convention.
Claude Code releases most days, so updates are checked daily, and its non-major updates go with the routine group like any other dependency.

packageRules.description: CI fails on the gitleaks release that scripts/gitleaks.ts pins until someone runs `bun run gitleaks` on its branch.
The check runs oxfmt --check on the whole repository, so a 0.x update that changes formatting fails it instead of merging.
